text:
Mike Ortega: Quick sales -> CS handoff for Zenith Health (ZEN-3426). Closed as committed. ARR: $120k/year. Renewal date: 2027-04-15. Current state: POC on Hosted API (dev keys given), onboarding started (dev sandbox access granted yesterday). Main asks from their security team: SOC2 report + option for private deployment. Risk: MED-HIGH until we confirm private deployment path and SLA. Observed issue: intermittent latency spikes for batch embeddings. Repro attached below. Owners: @Sam Kim (CS lead), @Julia Park (Support eng). Please coord with Eng-ML if needed. Next steps I expect: kickoff call scheduling, enablement doc, triage latency, quick mitigations for POC. :point_down:

Sam Kim: Thanks @Mike. I'll take CS ownership. First pass plan: 1) schedule kickoff with Zenith PM (I'll send invite today), 2) deliver onboarding checklist + tailored quickstart (include how to switch to dedicated/private later), 3) run health check on their sample workload, 4) track renewal risk in R360 (mark MED-HIGH until SOC2 path confirmed). Assigning tasks below.

Sam Kim: Owners/tasks: - Sam: kickoff + enablement doc + renewal owner - Julia: triage latency + log capture - Kiran Rao: perf profiling / mitigation suggestions - Mike: intro to Zenith security contact (emailed copy to me)

Julia Park: I'll start triage. Can someone paste the minimal repro and a sample request payload? I need headers, sequence length, batch size.

Mike Ortega: Repro (copied from customer environment):
```bash
# example curl they used for embedding batch
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "open-embedding-large-v2", "inputs": [["doc1"], ["doc2"], ["doc3"]] }'
```

Logs snippet from their POC (latency spikes ~5-8s):
```
2026-02-18T14:02:12Z INFO request_id=xyz123 model=open-embedding-large-v2 tokens=~204 batch_size=3 latency_ms=118
2026-02-18T14:04:33Z INFO request_id=xyz124 model=open-embedding-large-v2 tokens=~204 batch_size=3 latency_ms=5200
2026-02-18T14:05:10Z INFO request_id=xyz125 model=open-embedding-large-v2 tokens=~204 batch_size=3 latency_ms=6000
```

Mike Ortega: They are on our standard hosted node pool in us-west-2. No dedicated reservation. They mentioned they might need private deployment evaluation if we can't meet consistent latency.

Kiran Rao: I'll take profiling. Initial guesses: 1) occasional kernel fallback or quantization path causing slow runs, 2) request queuing on heavily loaded nodes, or 3) batching mismatch causing repeated context loads. Quick mitigations to try for POC: - enable `kv_cache=true` on client if available - set `max_batch_size=8` in client batching config - use `model_variant=perf-quant` (if acceptable)

Kiran Rao: Example config snippet I recommend testing in their SDK client:
```json
{"batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 8, "max_latency_ms": 50}, "cache": {"kv_cache": true}}
```

Sam Kim: Good. Julia, can you capture logs for a 24-48h window and confirm node ids for the spikes? I want to see if it's node-affine. Also I'll prepare an enablement doc covering: SDK config, recommended batch settings, quick checks for tokenization, and escalation path to Dedicated/Private.

Julia Park: On it. Will pull logs and post node IDs by EOD. If I see a reproducible server-side error I'll open a support ticket and loop Eng-ML.

Sam Kim: I'll schedule a kickoff for tomorrow 10am PT and invite Zenith, Mike, Julia, Kiran. I'll also attach the draft enablement checklist to the invite.

Mike Ortega: Thanks team. One more: Zenith asked for a rough timeline for private deployment evaluation (ballpark). Can CS share an initial scope/estimate? I suggested we say 2-4 weeks for an initial feasibility and quote.

Sam Kim: I'll draft an evaluation scope doc and share it after the kickoff. We should note dependencies: SOC2 artifacts, network topology, and whether they want VPC/air-gapped.

Oncall Bot: Calendar invite created: "Zenith Health - Onboarding Kickoff" tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Mike Ortega: Please update me in-thread when the triage outcome is known. If latency is mitigated for POC we can de-risk renewal.

Sam Kim: Will do. Closing notes: capture all Zenith enablement feedback in the onboarding Confluence page under "customer-success/zenith-health" and mark follow-ups as tasks in R360.

Julia Park: Posted initial log analysis and node list: node-az-west-3b-013 (spikes correlated). Opening ticket ENG-5779 for kernel fallback analysis and tagging Kiran.

Kiran Rao: Acknowledged ENG-5779, starting profiling. I'll update with a quick mitigation PR if kernel fallback is the cause.

Mike Ortega: Appreciate it. :thumbsup:
